inclusions.source: What it offers is a private vehicle, a competent driver, and a comfortable crossing of terrain that most visitors only ever see from a plane window or skip entirely.
What it offers is a private vehicle, a competent driver, and a comfortable crossing of terrain that most visitors only ever see from a plane window or skip entirely.
Your driver meets you at your Luxor hotel at a time arranged in advance — expect an early-to-mid morning departure depending on where you are staying and how you want to arrive.

inclusions.text: Drop-off at your resort or hotel in Hurghada
inclusions.source: By early to mid afternoon, depending on departure time and traffic, you are pulling into your resort or hotel.
The vehicle is air-conditioned, which matters in Upper Egypt where daytime temperatures regularly exceed 35°C between April and October.

exclusions.source: There are no guide stops, no temple forecourts, no queues.
A pure transfer — no temple stops, no commentary, just the desert going past.
